lockerComparison.case: both locker trials keep tires on course and body clear of real gate posts
lockerComparison.progressAndCorridorAnchor: Original source Route.Spawn; tire strip and progress are not recentered on the low-side target.
lockerComparison.geometryPredicate: At every observed settle/drive tick, all four finite tire cylinders remain within the continuous 2.59 m inner-post half-width; final proof requires >=0.001 m tire clearance. The imported body OBB must clear all eight actual finite post axes with 0.16 m radius plus 0.001 m guard, using independently traced cooked top caps and 1.5 m spans. Geometry must be finite with >=240 observed poses each and exactly eight post checks per pose, zero overlaps. BodyEdge is informational: body overhang between finite posts is permitted.
lockerComparison.criteria: Locked progress > open progress + 0.5 m and > 8 m; tires remain on course and body OBB remains clear of all real guarded gateposts.
lockerComparison.correction: Both comparisons use the same -0.50 m low-side line, settled start and ordinary full-range forward-input controller. The experimental rollback input policy was reverted. Nominal center-point and continuous body-strip proxies are replaced by actual tire course bounds and finite-post/body-OBB checks. Vehicle geometry, collision, axle coupling and progress criteria are unchanged.

sustainedLoadedAxle.scope: RPM cap, sustained contact traction, inertia/tire-reaction/drag torque balance and engine-request bound. These standalone limiter checks supplement final native gameplay checks.

interruptedRuns.reason: Locker QA TestSteer input carried into later tests. Root stopped only the identified automated process; source fix clears TestSteer after the locker comparison.
interruptedRuns.role: Root-controlled interruption of an obsolete QA run; excluded from final acceptance and not a completed test report.
interruptedRuns.qaCorrection: Reset TestSteer to zero after the locker comparison so independent later fixtures do not inherit the driver controller input.

captureHistory.role: Historical pre-scan-UV package review; not the final asset or camera revision.
captureHistory.limitation: The old coast-labelled and quarry overview captures showed effectively the same quarry framing because the camera moved before deferred capture. The final QA camera now waits for capture before moving and fresh reviewers must explicitly verify distinct coast/quarry framing.

limits: Verification uses automated native driving and rendered captures; it does not represent a separate manual desktop or controller session.

The full Automotive Winter Scene is playable through a project-owned copy. Its authored landscape retains original static collision and materials; native rut deformation is disabled on that authored landscape. Native proving-ground snow remains deformable.

The complete winter road has not been continuously driven. Winter verification covers driving/braking at four starts and tire-support queries at every internal authored road join; those checks do not establish collision or momentum behavior on every hill, obstacle and terrain edge.
Coachwork clearance checks sample 337 actual source vertices and permit up to 1.2 inches of transient penetration; they do not prove clearance of every polygon in all terrain encounters.

The locker comparison is a bounded QA fixture with equal two-second settled starts, fourteen-second drives and the same ordinary player-range steering along a shared -0.50 m low-side line. Tire cylinders stay in the 2.59 m inner-post half-width with an additional 1 mm evidence margin; the body OBB clears the eight actual finite guarded posts at every observed pose. Body overhang between posts is valid. Original Route.Spawn anchors progress and course bounds. This does not establish completion of every climb or absence of interior rock contact.
Only the explicitly listed fresh images are claimed as visually reviewed. Representative boundary views do not cover every map edge.

Vehicle bodies remain reference-built approximations below production racing-game precision; Civic and Sprinter body shapes retain the preceding reconstruction while their wheels/tires are improved in this round.
Short capped GPU samples do not establish long-session thermal stability or identify the cause of whole-PC reboots.
Cool/Balanced performance samples use one stationary quarry view and are not whole-map averages; normal 60 FPS Quality thermals are not proven by these capped checks.
Material coverage and traction grade across terrain fringes; original surface classification continues to govern mark type and soil deformation.
